title: Sindh Regularization of Veterinary Doctors Appointed On Contract Basis Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Regularization of Veterinary Doctors Appointed On Contract Basis Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXIII OF 2018
ACT XXXIII OF 2018
SINDH REGULARIZATION OF VETERINARY DOCTORS
APPOINTED ON CONTRACT BASIS ACT, 2018
An Act to provide for the regularization of the services of certain
doctors appointed on contract basis under district-wise Veterinary Service
Program of Livestock and Fisheries Department, Government of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 25th May, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-11/2018,
dated 25.5.2018.---The Sindh
Regularization of Veterinary Doctors appointed on Contract Basis Bill, 2018
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 09th May, 2018 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 23rd May 2018 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient in the public interest
to provide for the regularization of the services of certain doctors appointed
on contract basis under district-wise Veterinary Service Program of Livestock
and Fisheries Department, Government of Sindh, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Regularization of Veterinary Doctors appointed on
Contract Basis Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

2. Definitions.---In this Art, unless context otherwise requires -
(a) "Act"
means the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973;
(b) "appointment
of a Veterinary Doctor on contract" means the appointment of a duly
qualified Veterinary doctor made on contract basis in the Program;
(c) "civil
servant" shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in the Act;
(d) "Government"
means the Government of Sindh;
(e) "post"
means a post sanctioned by Government connected with the affairs of the
Province but does not include the post earmarked for a Project and co-exist
with such Project; and
(f) "Program"
means the district-wise Veterinary Service Program of Livestock and Fisheries
Department, Government of Sindh.

sections.description:
Regularization of services of Veterinary doctors

ACT XXXIII OF 2018
ACT XXXIII OF 2018
SINDH REGULARIZATION OF VETERINARY DOCTORS APPOINTED ON CONTRACT BASIS
ACT, 2018
An Act to provide for the regularization of the services of certain
doctors appointed on contract basis under district-wise Veterinary Service
Program of Livestock and Fisheries Department, Government of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 25th May, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-11/2018,
dated 25.5.2018.---The Sindh
Regularization of Veterinary Doctors appointed on Contract Basis Bill, 2018
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 09th May, 2018 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 23rd May 2018 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient in the public interest
to provide for the regularization of the services of certain doctors appointed
on contract basis under district-wise Veterinary Service Program of Livestock
and Fisheries Department, Government of Sindh, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
3. Regularization
of services of Veterinary doctors.---Notwithstanding
anything contained in the Act or rules made thereunder or any decree, order or
Judgment of a court, but subject to other provisions of this Act, a Veterinary
doctor appointed on contract basis in the Program and holding such post
immediately before the commencement of this Act, shall be deemed to have been
validly appointed to that post as a civil servant on regular basis, with effect
from the time date of commencement of this Act:
Provided
that the services of Veterinary Doctor, who does not possess the
qualifications, prescribed for the post, shall not be regularized.
Provided
further that no Veterinary Doctor shall be transferred from the District unless
the replacement of such doctor is available.
